subject: OCTOBER 2026 • VOLUME 02 - CALLED TO A DEEPER WALK
body:
## 🌿 Welcome to October
## A New Month. A Fresh Call. A Deeper Walk.

Dear Beloved CCG World Family,

Welcome to the October edition of the CCG World Chronicle.

As we enter the final quarter of the year, we have every reason to pause and give thanks. God has carried us through the months behind us and continues to lead us into the days ahead.

October brings with it a special call to spiritual reflection, prayer, and renewed commitment to God.

This month, may we not simply count the remaining days of the year, but make every day count for God's Kingdom.


## 📖 This Month's Message
# "Called to a Deeper Walk"

The Christian journey is not simply about where we have been; it is about continuing to move closer to God.

There are moments when God calls us to pause, examine our hearts, and renew our commitment to Him.

As we approach the final months of 2026, let us ask ourselves:

Are we growing?

Are we serving?

Are we praying?

Are we drawing closer to God?

October gives us another opportunity to answer that call.

"Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you."
— James 4:8, KJV

May this month bring us into a deeper relationship with God and a stronger desire to serve Him.


## 🎶 September Highlight
# National Choir Conference

**"The Call for Sacrifice of Praise and Worship"**

September came to a beautiful close with the recently concluded National Choir Conference, bringing together members of the choir ministry for a special time of worship, fellowship, learning, and spiritual reflection.

**Theme:** *"The Call for Sacrifice of Praise and Worship"*

 "O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms."
 — Psalm 95:1–2, KJV

The theme reminded us that true praise and worship go beyond music or performance. Worship is a response of the heart. It calls us to give God our best, to praise Him even when it requires sacrifice, and to make worship a lifestyle.

We celebrate everyone who participated in, supported, and contributed to the success of the conference. May the call to sacrificial praise continue long after the conference has ended.


## 🙏 This Month's Major Spiritual Focus
# Annual Week of Fasting & Prayer

One of the most important spiritual activities for the CCG family this month is our Annual Week of Fasting and Prayer.

**📅 Sunday, 11th October – Saturday, 17th October 2026**

This will be a special opportunity for the entire church family to seek God together through fasting, prayer, and spiritual reflection. As individuals, families, and a church, let us prepare our hearts for this important week.

*A week to seek. A week to pray. A week to draw closer to God.*

During this period, let us remember our families, our church, our ministers, our youths, our children, our communities, and the work God has entrusted to us.

Do not simply participate physically — prepare your heart to meet with God.



## 🕯️ Preparing for the Fast
# Make Room for God

Fasting is more than abstaining from food. It is an opportunity to intentionally create room for prayer, reflection, repentance, worship, and seeking God's direction.

As we prepare for the Annual Week of Fasting and Prayer:

- 📖 Spend more time in God's Word.

- 🙏 Make prayer a priority.

- ❤️ Examine your heart.

- 🤝 Reconcile where necessary.

- 🎶 Make worship part of your daily walk.

Let this year's fasting be a meaningful spiritual experience — not simply another event on the church calendar.



## 🎙️ A Moment A Day
# One Moment. Every Day.

Have you discovered *A Moment A Day* on CCG World? This feature provides a short daily audio experience designed to help you pause, listen, and reflect on God's Word.

**🎧 Just 1–5 minutes a day.**

In the middle of a busy schedule, take a moment.

Listen. Reflect. Pray.

A little time with God can make a big difference in your day.


## ⛪ Divine Service
# Everything You Need for Worship

The dedicated Divine Service section on CCG World continues to make worship resources more accessible.

Within this section, members can find the materials needed for the Divine Service in one convenient place, including the Ten Commandments and other resources that support meaningful participation in worship.

Whether you're preparing for service or following along during worship, CCG World puts these resources within easy reach.

*Your worship resources. One place. Always within reach.*


## 📱 CCG World
# Your Church. Now in Your Pocket.

CCG World continues to bring the church closer to you. From spiritual resources to church activities, the platform is designed to help you stay connected wherever you are — explore, listen, read, worship, and grow.

- 📖 Daily Devotional
- 📚 Sabbath School
- 📕 KJV Bible
- 🎶 CCG Hymnal
- 📝 Church Blog
- 🔴 Live Services
- 🎙️ Podcasts
- ⛪ Divine Service
- ✨ A Moment A Day

*Your church family, wherever life takes you.*


## 💡 Family Spotlight
# The Power of Serving Together

One of the beautiful things about the CCG family is the variety of gifts God has placed among us.

Some sing. Some teach. Some preach. Some organize. Some pray quietly behind the scenes. Some serve where few people see them.

Yet every contribution matters.

The recently concluded Choir Conference reminds us that ministry requires commitment, dedication, and sacrifice. There is a place for you in God's work. Do not wait for someone else to serve.

Ask yourself: *"What can I do for God and His people?"*


## 📖 Scripture for the Month

 "But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you."
 — Matthew 6:33, KJV

As we enter the final quarter of the year, may this Scripture become more than a verse we read. May it become our priority.

Before the plans. Before the ambitions. Before the worries. Before everything else —

**Seek God first.**


## 🎊 Celebrating Our Family
# Looking Back With Gratitude

As we move through the year, we have many reasons to give thanks.

We celebrate our youths, women, men, children, ministers, workers, choir members, and every individual who continues to contribute to the growth of the CCG family.

We celebrate every successful programme. Every answered prayer. Every testimony. Every act of service. Every soul encouraged.

God has been faithful. And our story is still being written.


## 🙏 Prayer Corner
# A Prayer for October

Heavenly Father,

We thank You for bringing us into another month. Thank You for Your faithfulness throughout the year and for every blessing, lesson, and testimony You have given us.

As we enter October, draw us closer to You. Prepare our hearts for the Annual Week of Fasting and Prayer. Give us the discipline to seek You sincerely and the faith to trust You completely.

Teach us to worship You not only with our lips but with our lives.

Bless our families, our church, our ministers, our youths, our children, and every member of the CCG family.

As the year draws toward its end, help us to finish strong and remain faithful to the end.

**In Jesus' name,**
# Amen.



## ❤️ From Your CCG Family

Dear CCG Family,

We have entered the final quarter of another year.

There is still time to pray.
There is still time to serve.
There is still time to grow.
There is still time to make a difference.

Do not allow the year to end without becoming closer to God than you were when it began.

As we prepare for our Annual Week of Fasting and Prayer, let us come together with one heart and one purpose — to seek God.

Let us continue to encourage one another, support one another, and walk together in faith.

**One family. One faith. One mission.**

With love,
*The CCG World Family*



📩 **Want this delivered straight to your inbox?** Subscribe to the CCG World Chronicle 👉👉 https://ccgm-pwa.vercel.app/newsletter#subscribe and never miss an edition.



## 🌿 Until the Next Edition

October is only one chapter in our journey. As we continue toward the end of 2026, may every month bring us closer to God and closer to one another.

Thank you for being part of the CCG World family.

Keep the faith.
Keep serving.
Keep praying.
Keep worshipping.
Keep God First.

**See you in the November edition!**

🕊️ **CCG WORLD**

*God First.*

subject: SEPTEMBER 2026 • VOLUME 01 - "Renewed In Faith And Strength"
body:
## 🌿 Welcome to CCG World Chronicle

# Our Maiden Edition

Dear Beloved CCG World Family,

Welcome to the maiden edition of the CCG World Chronicle!

It gives us great joy to begin this monthly journey together — sharing the stories, activities, celebrations, announcements, and spiritual encouragement that connect us as one church family.

From this edition onward, the CCG World Chronicle will be published on the first Sunday of every month, bringing you a fresh look at what's happening across our family and what lies ahead.

As we begin, may this newsletter become more than information — may it be a source of encouragement, connection, and inspiration.

Welcome to CCG World Chronicle.

**One Family. One Faith. One Mission.**

## 📖 This Month's Message

# Renewed in Faith & Strength

There are seasons when we need more than a fresh start — we need fresh strength.

September invites us to look beyond yesterday and embrace what God is doing today. Whatever the past months have brought, God's grace remains sufficient and His faithfulness remains sure.

Let us continue to walk by faith, trusting God even when we cannot see the whole journey ahead.

*"Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)"*

**— Hebrews 10:23, KJV**

May this month bring renewed faith, renewed strength, and renewed purpose to every member of the CCG family.

## 🏆 Highlights of Last Month

# August — A Month of Fellowship & Faith

August was a beautiful month of spiritual activity and fellowship across the CCG family.

**👩🏽 Women's Convention**

From the 25th to the 28th of August, our mothers gathered for a special convention centered on the theme:

*"Christian Women as of Old."*

It was a time of worship, teaching, fellowship, and reflection on the godly examples of women who faithfully served God. We thank God for the success of the convention and for everyone who participated, served, and contributed.

August may be behind us, but its blessings and lessons continue with us.

## 🎉 September Highlights

# 16th Mega Youth In Conference With Jesus 2026

September opened with a major celebration of faith and youth fellowship. From the 1st to the 4th, young people gathered at Faith Camp, Obor, for the 16th Mega Youth In Conference With Jesus 2026.

**Theme:** *"Renewed in Faith and Strength"*

It was an opportunity for our young people to worship, learn, connect, reflect, and renew their walk with Christ. We celebrate every youth, minister, worker, volunteer, and supporter who contributed to the conference's success.

May the renewal experienced there become a lifestyle far beyond the conference grounds.

## 🎶 Coming Up

# National Choir Conference

The sound of worship continues! Our church family looks forward to the National Choir Conference, taking place:

**📅 30th September – 2nd October 2026**

This gathering brings members of the choir ministry together for worship, learning, fellowship, and spiritual development.

Prepare your heart, prepare your voice, and come ready to give God the praise He deserves.

*When we sing, we proclaim. When we worship, we draw near.*

## 🙏 Coming Next Month

# Annual Week of Fasting & Prayer

October will usher in another important spiritual season — our Annual Week of Fasting and Prayer. As a church family, we will take time to seek God, pray for our families and church, intercede for our nation, and commit the days ahead into His hands.

Start preparing your heart now. Set aside the distractions. Make room for prayer. Let us prepare to seek God together, as one family.

## ✨ New Features

# More Ways to Connect, Worship & Grow

CCG World continues to grow, bringing more of our church's resources and experiences directly to you.

**🎙️ A Moment A Day**

Start your day with a moment in God's Word. *A Moment A Day* brings you a short daily audio reflection, just 1–5 minutes long.

Listen. Reflect. Pray. Begin your day with God.

*One moment. Every day. A closer walk with God.*

**⛪ Divine Service**

We're also excited to introduce a dedicated Divine Service section on CCG World, bringing together everything you need to prepare, participate, and follow along — including the Ten Commandments and other resources designed to enrich your worship experience.

*Everything you need for Divine Service — together in one place.*

## 📱 CCG World

# Your Church. Now in Your Pocket.

Your church is closer than ever. Through the CCG World app, you can access a growing collection of church resources wherever you are — explore, listen, read, worship, and grow.

📖 Daily Devotional  •  📚 Sabbath School  •  📕 KJV Bible  •  🎶 CCG Hymnal  •  📝 Church Blog  •  🔴 Live Services  •  🎙️ Podcasts  •  ⛪ Divine Service  •  ✨ A Moment A Day

CCG World is your digital connection to the church family.

## 💡 Family Spotlight

# We Are Better Together

A church is more than a building. It is people — people who pray together, worship together, serve together, encourage one another, and grow together.

Every member of the CCG family has a part to play. Whether through singing, teaching, giving, praying, evangelism, service, or simply encouraging someone who needs a word of hope — your contribution matters.

Together, we are one family.

## 📖 Scripture for the Month

*"And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works."*

**— Hebrews 10:24, KJV**

This month, let us intentionally encourage someone.

Be the reason someone smiles. Be the reason someone keeps going. Be the reason someone remembers God's love.

Let love become something we do, not just something we speak about.

## 🎊 Celebrating Our Family

# Every Member. Every Story. Every Victory.

There is always something worth celebrating within the CCG family. We celebrate our children, youths, women, men, families, workers, ministers, choirs, and every member who continues to contribute to the growth of God's work.

We celebrate the victories we can see, and the testimonies still unfolding.

Your service matters. Your prayers matter. Your presence matters.

## 🙏 Prayer Corner

# A Prayer for September

Heavenly Father,

Thank You for bringing us into another month, and for Your unfailing faithfulness. Renew our faith and strengthen our hearts. Help us remain steadfast in Your Word and faithful in our service.

Bless our families, our children, our youths, our ministers, our officers, our workers, and every member of the CCG family. Guide our church, and let everything we do bring glory to Your name.

May this month bring spiritual growth, divine strength, open doors, and testimonies. Grant us speed, lead us through the remaining months of this year, and help us finish strong.

In Jesus' name, Amen.

## ❤️ From Your CCG Family

Dear CCG Family,

As we journey through September, let us remember that we do not walk alone. We are part of a family — a family called to love, serve, encourage, and grow together.

Whatever this season brings, keep your eyes on Christ. Keep praying. Keep believing. Keep serving.

There is still much ahead of us, and we trust the God who has brought us this far to lead us into greater things.

Wishing you all *Godspeed* for the remainder of the year

**God First. Always.**

With love, *The CCG World Family*



## 🌿 Until the Next Edition

And so we come to the end of our maiden edition. Thank you for being part of this new chapter of CCG World.

As we continue this monthly journey, we look forward to sharing more stories, celebrating more victories, announcing more events, and growing together as one family.

Until the next edition: Keep the faith. Keep serving. Keep growing. Keep God First.

**See you on the first Sunday of October!**

🕊️ **CCG WORLD**

*One Family. One Faith. One Mission. God First.*
